component.name: SpareEye
component.summary: Turn a spare computer into a private security camera

description.p: SpareEye watches a webcam for movement and sends a snapshot and a short video clip to a Telegram chat when it sees any. Sensitivity, recording length and a separate night-time profile are all configurable from the application itself.
Recordings are kept locally and pruned on a retention schedule. Note that alert footage is uploaded to Telegram's servers, so consider who might appear in view of the camera.
